scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @causality/contracts build && pnpm --filter @causality/semantic-core build && pnpm --parallel --filter @causality/api --filter @causality/semantic-worker --filter @causality/mcp --filter @causality/web dev
scripts.dev:semantic-worker: pnpm --filter @causality/contracts build && pnpm --filter @causality/semantic-core build && pnpm --filter @causality/semantic-worker dev
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @causality/contracts typecheck && pnpm --filter @causality/semantic-core typecheck && pnpm --filter @causality/api typecheck && pnpm --filter @causality/semantic-worker typecheck && pnpm --filter @causality/mcp typecheck && pnpm --filter @causality/web typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @causality/contracts test && pnpm --filter @causality/semantic-core test && pnpm --filter @causality/api test && pnpm --filter @causality/semantic-worker test && pnpm --filter @causality/mcp test && pnpm --filter @causality/web test
scripts.test:mcp-compat: pnpm --filter @causality/contracts build && pnpm --filter @causality/mcp build && pnpm --filter @causality/mcp test:compat
scripts.test:integration: DOCKER_HOST="${DOCKER_HOST:-$(docker context inspect --format '{{.Endpoints.docker.Host}}')}" TESTCONTAINERS_DOCKER_SOCKET_OVERRIDE="${TESTCONTAINERS_DOCKER_SOCKET_OVERRIDE:-/var/run/docker.sock}" sh -c 'pnpm --filter @causality/api test:integration && pnpm --filter @causality/semantic-worker test:integration'
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @causality/contracts build && pnpm --filter @causality/semantic-core build && pnpm --filter @causality/api build && pnpm --filter @causality/semantic-worker build && pnpm --filter @causality/mcp build && pnpm --filter @causality/web build
